LanguageData.RP_TrustyGrantDesc: Trusties work in the outside work zone beyond the wall, in their work hours, while guards stand near it. A minimum-security inmate with a high conduct grade, no serious trouble lately and a calm temper can be made one. They lose the status for serious misconduct, any escape, or a move off minimum security.
LanguageData.RP_TrustyEndDesc: The inmate is no trusty from now on and loses the outside job. One standing outside the wall walks back in on the pass they hold.

LanguageData.RP_DeployTrustiesTip: Trusties work in the outside work zone in their work hours, in a party that goes out only while enough guards stand near the zone. A guard on duty near the zone counts, and so does an open guard post within ten cells of it. A post counts only while a guard is on it or on the way. A riot, a hostage crisis, a raid, an evacuation, a lockdown of the minimum wing or an escape somebody has seen calls the party in at once, and so does an hour of too few guards.
